questions.q: Why did Mowgli not stay in the first village he came to after leaving the wolves?
choices: It was too near the jungle, and he had made an enemy at the Council
The villagers there chased him away with sticks and their barking dogs
Bagheera had told him to travel at least twenty miles from home
He could not find any food or water anywhere near that village
questions.evidence: he would not stop there because it was too near to the jungle

questions.q: How did Mowgli show the man at the village gate that he wanted food?
choices: He opened his mouth and pointed down it
He gave the Strangers' Hunting Call
He held out an empty wicker pot to him
He rubbed his stomach and howled
questions.evidence: opened his mouth, and pointed down it to show that he wanted food

questions.q: What did the priest say the scars on Mowgli's arms and legs were?
choices: The bites of wolves
Burns from a fire
Scratches from thorns
Marks from a tiger's claws
questions.evidence: They are the bites of wolves.

questions.q: Why did the priest tell Messua to take the boy into her house?
choices: Messua was the wife of the richest villager, and he wanted to please her
He was afraid the wild boy would attack the village if he were turned away
He knew for certain that Mowgli was really Messua's long-lost son
The village head-man had ordered him to find the boy a home at once
questions.evidence: he knew that Messua was wife to the richest villager in the place

questions.q: How did Messua know that Mowgli was probably not her real son Nathoo?
choices: His feet were as hard as horn and had never worn shoes
He did not answer when she called him by the name Nathoo
He was much taller than her boy would have been by then
He had eyes like red fire, and Nathoo's eyes were dark
questions.evidence: those feet have never worn shoes

questions.q: How did Mowgli learn to speak the villagers' language so quickly?
choices: He copied each word Messua said, as he copied jungle animals
Messua's husband taught him for hours every night by the fire
He remembered the words from when he was a baby in the village
The village children played word games with him in the street
questions.evidence: as soon as Messua pronounced a word Mowgli would imitate it almost perfectly

questions.q: Why did Mowgli go out through the window at bedtime?
choices: The hut looked too much like a panther trap to sleep in
He wanted to slip back into the jungle to see Bagheera again
He was too hot inside under the heavy thatched roof
He heard Gray Brother calling him from the field
questions.evidence: so like a panther trap as that hut

questions.q: What news did Gray Brother bring about Shere Khan on Mowgli's first night in the village?
choices: He had gone far off to hunt until his singed coat grew again
He had been made the new leader of the Seeonee wolf pack
He was waiting in the bamboos to catch Mowgli that very night
He had been shot by the village hunter beside the river
questions.evidence: Shere Khan has gone away to hunt far off till his coat grows again

questions.q: What kept Mowgli from hurting the village children when they made fun of him?
choices: He knew it was unsportsmanlike to kill little naked cubs
Messua had made him promise never to harm anyone
He was afraid the priest would send him back to the jungle
He did not know how strong he really was compared to them
questions.evidence: it was unsportsmanlike to kill little naked cubs

questions.q: What led to Mowgli being sent out to herd the buffaloes?
choices: He helped the potter's donkey, then threatened the priest who scolded him
He refused to wear a cloth and ran naked up and down the village streets
He told Messua that he wanted to go back and live with the wolves
He won a fight with the village boys and was made their leader
questions.evidence: Mowgli threatened to put him on the donkey too

choices: The village hunter with a Tower musket
The village priest who wore a red mark
Messua's husband and the richest man
The head-man who gave Mowgli his orders
questions.evidence: old Buldeo, the village hunter, who had a Tower musket

questions.q: Why did Mowgli have to hide his face while Buldeo told stories about the jungle?
choices: He was laughing, because he knew the stories were not true
He was crying, because the stories made him miss his wolf family
He was frightened by Buldeo's tales of ghosts and goblins
He was falling asleep and did not want the old men to notice
questions.evidence: had to cover his face not to show that he was laughing

questions.q: According to Mowgli, why does Shere Khan really limp?
choices: He was born lame
A hunter's bullet hit him
He was hurt in a riot
A ghost lives in his body
questions.evidence: That tiger limps because he was born lame

questions.q: Buldeo "puffed and snorted at Mowgli's impertinence." What does "impertinence" mean?
choices: Rude lack of respect
Great skill at hunting
Quiet, shy behavior
Careless forgetfulness
questions.evidence: puffed and snorted at Mowgli's impertinence

questions.q: Why are herd boys usually safe from the tiger?
choices: Not even the tiger will charge a mob of cattle
The tiger only hunts at night, when the boys are home
Each herd boy carries a musket like Buldeo's
The village dogs always follow the herds and bark
questions.evidence: not even the tiger will charge a mob of cattle

questions.q: What signal did Mowgli and Gray Brother agree on while Shere Khan was away?
choices: A wolf would sit on a rock where Mowgli could see it from the village
Gray Brother would howl three times at sunset from the bamboo clump
Mowgli would leave a buffalo near the river when he needed help
A kite would circle over the plain whenever the tiger came back
questions.evidence: sit on that rock, so that I can see thee as I come out of the village

questions.q: What did Gray Brother learn from Tabaqui about Shere Khan's plan?
choices: He would wait for Mowgli at the village gate that evening
He would attack the buffalo herd down at the river that noon
He would hunt Mowgli at the dhak tree the next morning
He would go back to the Council Rock to lead the wolves
questions.evidence: Shere Khan's plan is to wait for thee at the village gate this evening

questions.q: What is this part of the story mostly about?
choices: Mowgli learns to live among men as Shere Khan plans to kill him
Mowgli finds his real mother and forgets all about the jungle
Buldeo the hunter teaches Mowgli how to track and shoot tigers
Gray Brother leads the wolf pack in a great hunt near the village
questions.evidence: But he means to kill thee.
